work_item: explicit alpha 7 to alpha 8 Rust store migration
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

observed_migration.legacy_fixture: A temporary alpha 8-created store was labeled alpha 7 and given a schema-identified legacy RECEIVED case revision with a digest-addressed blob.
observed_migration.integrity_negative: Corrupting the referenced legacy blob caused INTEGRITY_FAILURE; store_metadata.schema remained minidora-rust/0.7.0-alpha.7. Restoring the original digest-matching bytes allowed migration.
observed_migration.migration: Store::migrate_alpha7_to_alpha8 returned true; reopening and loading retained revision 0 with its alpha 7 schema identity and the same state blob digest. A second verified migration returned false.
observed_migration.cli: The installed binary rejects migrate without an explicit --db and creates no default state directory. Against an alpha 8 state, --json reported migrated=false; a saved calculation result before and after the command was identical.
observed_migration.write_scope: The migration transaction updates only store_metadata.schema. It verifies current SQLite WAL/FULL/FK settings and referenced blobs, case journals, action journals and conflict chains before the update.

not_run: Migration of a user-provided or independently produced alpha 7 database
A populated legacy external-effect journal fixture
Power-loss/crash interruption at each migration boundary
Physical Windows, macOS or other-target durability checks
